property_summary: After any successful call to SetMinSum by any caller, the public MinSum getter on the reference contract remains settable by subsequent calls (i.e. SetMinSum can be called again when not yet initialized), whereas the mutant that fails to reset the nonReentrant_ lock can permanently block further SetMinSum calls causing SetMinSum to become unchangeable for some inputs (caller sequences); the test fuzzes caller and value to find a sequence where the mutant blocks a second SetMinSum call while the reference allows it.
change_summary: Modified the nonReentrant_ modifier to omit setting locked_ back to false after function execution, leaving the contract permanently locked and potentially preventing subsequent SetMinSum calls from succeeding.
